displayName: vastgrid: CSV, Parquet and Excel Viewer
description: Huge CSV, Parquet, Excel and JSON Lines files in a grid: scroll millions of rows, sort, filter and group them, and edit CSV and TSV files in place.
untrustedWorkspaces: In a workspace that is not trusted, files open read-only: cells cannot be edited or saved.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with vastgrid
walkthrough.description: Open CSV, Parquet, Excel and JSON Lines files of any size in a grid, explore them, and edit CSV and TSV files.
walkthrough.open.title: Open a file in the grid
walkthrough.open.description:
Parquet, Excel and DuckDB files open in vastgrid. CSV, TSV and JSON Lines files open as text: the vastgrid button at the top right of the editor, or **Open in vastgrid** in the Explorer's context menu, shows them in the grid. In an Excel file, the bar above the grid or **vastgrid: Choose Sheet** chooses the sheet, and in a DuckDB database the table.
[Open a File](command:workbench.action.files.openFile)
walkthrough.open.alt: A CSV file open as text, with the vastgrid button at the top right of the editor.
walkthrough.explore.title: Sort, filter and group
walkthrough.explore.description: Click a column's name to sort by it. The arrow at its right opens the column's menu: **Filter…** lists the column's values with how many rows have each, and **Group by this column** and **Statistics…** are there too. The whole file is sorted, filtered and grouped, not only the rows on screen.
walkthrough.explore.alt: The filter of the city column of 100,000,000 rows, with how many rows have each city.
walkthrough.select.title: Count and sum a selection
walkthrough.select.description: Select cells with the pointer, or with Shift and the arrow keys: Shift+⌘↓ (Shift+Ctrl+↓) selects to the last row. The status bar shows their count, sum and average, over every row selected.
walkthrough.select.alt: The prices of 100,000,000 rows selected, with their count, sum and average in the status bar.
walkthrough.edit.title: Edit and save CSV and TSV files
walkthrough.edit.description: Type in a cell, or press F2, to edit it, and paste, clear and fill cells as in a spreadsheet. Undo, Redo and Save are VS Code's: Save writes the changed cells into the file and keeps every other byte as it was. Save As writes the table as CSV, TSV, Parquet, JSON or Excel.
walkthrough.edit.alt: A CSV file in vastgrid, with a cell being edited and the editor's tab marked as unsaved.
